title: Rest-area food on a stated route, with menu and price

turns.say: 내일 서울에서 부산까지 경부고속도로로 운전해서 내려가.
가는 길에 휴게소에서 먹을 만한 거 추천해줘. 메뉴랑 가격까지.

good_secretary: Names specific rest areas on the Gyeongbu route in driving order, specific signature menus with prices and where that information came from, and flags prices/opening as possibly outdated if not verified.

title: Rest-area recommendation corrected by a later budget

turns.say: 주말에 서울에서 강릉까지 영동고속도로로 갈 거야.
중간에 휴게소 하나 들러서 밥 먹을 건데 추천해줘.
아 그리고 한 사람당 만 원 이하로 먹고 싶어.

good_secretary: Turn 2 names specific rest areas on the Yeongdong route. Turn 3 revises its own earlier picks to options under 10,000 won per person and says which earlier suggestion no longer fits.

title: Weekday lunch near a stated workplace

turns.say: 나 평일에는 을지로입구역 근처 한빛타워로 출근해.
오늘 점심 회사 근처에서 뭐 먹을지 추천해줘. 걸어서 10분 안쪽으로.

good_secretary: Keeps the stated workplace (records it or proposes remembering it), then recommends specific restaurants near Euljiro 1-ga station within a short walk, with menu/price hints and sources, without asking where the office is.

title: 'I already ate' after a lunch recommendation

turns.say: 아 근데 나 벌써 김치찌개 먹었어.

good_secretary: Acknowledges it missed the timing, records (or proposes recording) that lunch was kimchi stew so later suggestions avoid repeating it, and does not keep pushing lunch options.

title: Already ate dinner, plan the next meal without repeating

turns.say: 아까 6시에 이미 초밥 먹었어. 내일 점심은 겹치지 않게 추천해줘.

good_secretary: Acknowledges dinner already happened, keeps that it was sushi, and suggests tomorrow's lunch that is clearly not raw fish/Japanese.
